mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic properties and CNS effects; rivastigmine (cholinesterase inhibitor) increases acetylcholine which may oppose fluphenazine's antipsychotic effects, while fluphenazine's anticholinergic activity may reduce rivastigmine efficacy.
action: Monitor for reduced efficacy of both agents and increased anticholinergic side effects; consider alternative antipsychotic with fewer anticholinergic properties if used in dementia patients.
